scoreChangeReason: The prior catalogue score omitted category curation and the daily Glencadam visitor centre opened in 2025; five independent in-boundary visitor experiences and complete practical provision now support the Strong Destination band.

namedTrailSearch.TreasureTrails: No dedicated Brechin product found after direct search and link check

practicalAudit.picnic: Inch Park retained as blanket-picnic green space; no dedicated table is claimed
practicalAudit.parking: All six current council car parks are published with official bay counts, stay limits, permanently free status and official polygon centroids; railway and Glencadam customer parking remain documented on their attraction records rather than misrepresented as public parking
practicalAudit.toilets: Church Street public toilets plus limited-hour railway and Glencadam customer toilets
practicalAudit.accessibility: Glencadam is fully accessible; railway uses ramps; cathedral main areas are level according to the current church listing; rural path surfaces vary
practicalAudit.transport: Bus-accessible town; the Caledonian Railway is a heritage attraction, not a regular passenger rail service
